title: Demon at the Locked Hour
description: A horned demonic creature with glowing orange eyes, blue-black scales and dripping red-orange liquid stands in the rain outside a dark apothecary shop. A hooded figure holding a glowing blue vial stands in the open doorway, surrounded by skulls, ghosts, potion signs and overgrown nightshade plants under a stormy sky.
prompt: A menacing horned demon with glowing orange eyes, dark blue scales and viscous red liquid dripping from its body stands in heavy rain outside an old gothic apothecary at night. A hooded figure holding a glowing blue potion stands in the vine-covered doorway. Floating skulls and ghosts surround the scene, with signs reading 'Locked Hour Potions' and 'Stasis & Vellum - Open 'Til The Locked Hour'. Overgrown poisonous plants and puddles on the ground, dark stormy atmosphere, detailed dark fantasy illustration.
